scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @qqbot/contracts && npm run build -w @qqbot/onebot && npm run build -w @qqbot/server
scripts.typecheck:server: npm run build -w @qqbot/contracts && npm run build -w @qqbot/onebot && npm run typecheck -w @qqbot/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @qqbot/onebot && npm run typecheck -w @qqbot/server && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.verify:server: npm run typecheck:server && npm test && npm run build:server
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm --prefix web-ui run build
scripts.verify: npm run verify:server && npm --prefix web-ui run lint && npm --prefix web-ui run deploy:full
